title: A Note to Say Sorry

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a note

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Oh, I feel dreadful. Before we found her, my lamb wandered through Miss Miriam's garden and trampled her flowers.

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: I want to tell Miriam I'm sorry. Will you help me write a note?

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Help Mrs. Ruth write her note: choose a word for each coloured space.

feedback.all_good: That's a good, honest note. Let's take it to Miss Miriam.

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Miriam read it, and hugged me! She said, "Of course I forgive you. Let's plant them again together."

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: Saying sorry is hard. Forgiving is a gift. Thank you for helping me.

journal_line: I helped Mrs. Ruth write a note to say sorry, and Miss Miriam forgave her.
unavailable_text: The sorry note is written and given.
